build-settings.description: Writes Xcode.xcconfig, .swiftlint.yml, Directory.Build.props, mise.toml and pixi platform rows from root package.json and Package.swift

barrels.description: Writes each library's index.ts barrels from its package.json exports and modules

catalog-mirror.description: Writes every default pnpm catalog key into root devDependencies

swift-dependencies.description: Writes each Package.swift target dependencies argument from the modules its sources import

injection-utils.description: Writes each ast-grep rule's injection-utils metadata entry rule and utils it calls from sgconfig.yml languageInjections

outline-catalogs.description: Writes each sgconfig.yml outlineRules catalog from its sources document, its language, and the shared utils, rewriters, and transforms each document calls

effect-operations.description: Writes the ast-grep Effect operation utils from the duals and overloads of each catalog effect and @effect package module

rust-analyzer.description: Writes .vscode/settings.json rust-analyzer check and rustc rows from the argus .lsp.json rust row

hosting-bindings.description: Writes each .openai/hosting.json d1 and r2 members from its cloudflare.config.ts bindings
